LAND_REGISTRATION: Upload the registered ownership deed or valid registered lease for the campus. Include the institution or sponsoring body's name, survey numbers, land area and registration details.
COMPLETION: Upload the completion or occupancy certificate issued by the competent local authority. The campus address, approved building use and certified built-up area must be readable.
FIRE_SAFETY: Upload the current certificate from the fire authority showing the campus address, certificate number, issue date and validity or expiry date.
AFFIDAVIT_2: Upload the signed and notarized Affidavit 2 in the applicable AICTE format on the prescribed stamp or e-stamp paper, including all pages and the authorized signatory's details.
FACULTY_LIST: Upload the programme-wise faculty list showing names, designations, qualifications, specialization, appointment dates and relevant supporting qualification records.
AUDITED_ACCOUNTS: Audited Financial Statements — Previous Financial Year
Upload the previous financial year's audited balance sheet, income and expenditure statement, and auditor's report for the sponsoring Trust, Society or Company.
AFFILIATION: Upload the current affiliation or consent letter identifying the institution, programmes, courses, approved intake and academic year.
STRUCTURAL_STABILITY: Upload the certificate from a qualified structural engineer identifying the buildings assessed, inspection date and assessment. The generated checklist explains when it is required.
AFFIDAVIT_7: For a leased-land new-institution proposal, upload the joint undertaking by the parties in the applicable format. Include the lease term, campus land details and signatures.
AFFIDAVIT_8: Upload the signed and notarized Affidavit 8 for the intake or additional-course request, where applicable. Extended EoA exemptions are evaluated separately.
FORMAT_3: Upload the Trust, Society or Company's resolution authorizing the proposed additional course or intake and the associated provision of land, building and funds.
CLOSURE_RESOLUTION: Closure Resolution and Student Protection Plan
Upload the governing body's resolution, reasons for closure, the proposed schedule, and arrangements to protect current students and retain their academic records.
SATELLITE_MAP: Campus Satellite Map and Entrance Coordinates
Upload a map identifying the campus boundary and main entrance, with clear latitude and longitude coordinates.
PAYMENT_RECEIPT: Upload the payment acknowledgment for this application year, showing the application reference, transaction number, date and amount.
